necessary_context.content: For x,y in Q and a in [0,1], f(a x+(1-a)y)<=a f(x)+(1-a)f(y)-(mu_f/2)a(1-a)[a^(rho-1)+(1-a)^(rho-1)]||x-y||^rho; finite rho>=2, mu_f>0 in the selected results.
necessary_context.name: Uniform convexity convention

necessary_context.content: E is finite-dimensional real with norm ||.||, dual norm ||.||_*; Q closed convex. Assumption 1 bounds all objective subgradients by L on Q. Deterministic setting provides exact subgradient and objective value observations.
necessary_context.name: Geometry and deterministic observations

necessary_context.content: B={u:||u||<=1}; d continuous and mu_d-strongly convex on B, d(u)>=d(0)=0 and d(u)<=A_d. Q_R(z)=Q intersect {x:||x-z||<=R}, d_zR(x)=d((x-z)/R). pi_zR,beta(s)=argmax over Q_R(z) of <s,x-z>-beta d_zR(x). Quadratic growth condition (9) is not required here.
necessary_context.name: Unit-ball prox and localization

necessary_context.content: The bracket in Algorithm 2 means greatest integer strictly smaller than its argument, including when the argument is an integer; denote it floor_strict(t).
necessary_context.name: Strict integer convention
